noise_model.equation: f*dT/dt = [I^2 R - S_env (T - T_base) + S_couple * sum_nn (T_n - T)]/Cth + sigma*xi,  f = Cth_factor = 0.15 (model.py)
noise_model.integrator: explicit Euler, y += dy*dt with the noise inside dy: per-step temperature kick = sigma*dt/f (NOT sigma*sqrt(dt)); not Euler-Maruyama
noise_model.report: give sigma in simulation units together with the per-step kick and sigma_T; the "0.2 uJ s^-1/2" equivalence is NOT verified, do not use

vo2_R_325K.note: use 51.84 (formula at exactly 325 K); 51.93 is the nearest point of the rt_loop temperature grid (324.97 K)

R4_fig2_sim.result: PASS (equivalent): idxA, VA, ydA, ycA identical; tfirstB identical for 783,993 of 784,000 neurons (7 differ by one step, 10 ns); onsetB max |diff| 5 events per step; IA max |diff| 0.024 mA (float16 storage + one-step shifts); VB max |diff| 0.0039 V (old file float16). earliest switch 2030 ns, never switching 0 %. make_fig1.py and make_fig3.py run unchanged on the new file.

R6_jitter.result: PASS (from printed output of the full run; the uploaded jitter.json was the smoke file): C0x0.5 jitter 4.841 / 4.33 ns, t1 1521, period 1464, 6 switches, 100 % — identical to ref (quantised by dt = 10 ns); C0x1.0 jitter 54.87 vs 55.17 ns, 3rd 35.33 vs 36.4, period 2457 vs 2462, ≥3-switch share 31.5 vs 32.2 %; C0x1.5 no neuron switches in all 8 realisations (as ref); sigma0 check identical (2790, 2495, jitter 0).
R6_jitter.confirms: original jitter used the first 32 test images (batch 32) and 8 realisations

R1_final_sigma0_60k.result: PASS: all 9 windows (27 accuracies) within 0.02 pp of sigma0_60k_final (max |diff| 0.02 pp; 21 of 27 identical); 18 of 19 sliding 1-us windows identical, max |diff| 0.02 pp; masked features 263 (identical); earliest switch 2030 ns, never switching 0 %, mean switches (test) 3.3708 = value in c0_sigma_grid_20k/coupling_sweep_20k; digit and parity confusion matrices identical cell by cell.
R1_final_sigma0_60k.difference: Full-window colour alpha: 100 (new) vs 31.6 (orig). Validation tie broken by 1-2 of 10,000 val images (orig 0.8026 vs 0.8024, new 0.8025 vs 0.8026), i.e. float-level GPU differences. Consequence: test colour 81.47 vs 81.48 %; colour confusion differs in 26 cells (max 9 images); per-colour pair accuracies 53.7-58.9 % (new) vs 54.3-58.2 % (orig); errors inside the two pairs 82.19 vs 82.24 %. Paper numbers and Fig. 4 stay on the original values; the difference is within numerical reproducibility.
R1_final_sigma0_60k.feat_var_note: printed FeatVar 1.5731 is from the first 5000 rows only; original all-row value 1.5826 not recomputed

R3_baselines_ABD.result: PASS: A 85.00 / 22.32 / 88.99 and D 86.40 / 88.28 / 89.19 identical to baselines_60k; B 94.87 / 43.19 / 96.08 vs ref 43.18 colour (1 test image, float-level). D digit accuracy by colour identical to the stored per-colour values (85.5-87.8 %).
R3_baselines_ABD.not_checked: D n_masked_features (2439) is not written by R3; not re-verified.
R3_baselines_ABD.new_observation_not_yet_in_paper: D colour errors: 86.6 % fall inside the two near-equal-voltage pairs (Red/DkGreen, Green/Orange); pair-colour accuracies 56.1-86.4 %. Same mechanism as the reservoir (82.2 %). Use only after Mana approves.

R5_diagnostics_dt.result: PASS: in all 24 configurations (c0 0.5/1.0 x sigma_eq 0-3e-4 x dt 10/5 ns), frac_ge3_switches (Fig. 5d), median switches and median reversals/us are identical to diagnostics_dt; FeatVar identical to 4-5 significant digits.
R5_diagnostics_dt.difference: switches_mean systematically 0.03-0.2 % lower (e.g. 3.3598 vs 3.3663 at c0=1.0, sigma 0, dt 10), also at sigma = 0, so it comes from switch counting rather than noise. Not used in the paper (the reported switch means 6.48 / 3.37 / 2.13 come from the 20k test runs, reproduced exactly by R1: 3.3708).
R5_diagnostics_dt.smoke_note: 64-image smoke gave FeatVar 2-3 % lower: sample-size effect only.

R2_noise_seeds_sigma2e-4.result: PASS (statistical): mean differs from the original by 0.02 / 0.14 / 0.01 pp, all within one seed s.d. Never-switching neurons 11.2 % (ref 11 %), mean switches (test) 2.847.
R2_noise_seeds_sigma2e-4.difference: Individual noise realisations are not identical to the original (seed 0: 87.43/77.76/90.11 vs 87.11/77.76/89.71), so the original per-seed values cannot be regenerated bit-for-bit. Paper keeps the original per-seed values and mean +/- s.d. (Fig. 2); the code reproduces them statistically.
R2_noise_seeds_sigma2e-4.observation: colour errors inside the two pairs 75.7-77.7 % (94-95 % with Purple) at sigma = 2e-4; not in paper.

reconstruction_checks._summary: All six reconstructed scripts R1-R6 verified 2026-11-02/03. Deterministic results (R1, R3, R4) reproduce within 0.02 pp / one image; stochastic results (R2, R5, R6) reproduce statistically (R5 Fig. 5d quantities identical). Basis for Data/Code availability: 'deterministic accuracies reproduced to within 0.02 percentage points; noisy results reproduced within the seed-to-seed spread'.

colour_label_independence.source: printed_output: color_independence_kaggle.py (Kaggle CPU, 2026-11-07, run 2 with the built-in check: PASS); JSON file not in hand
colour_label_independence.check: colour assignment verified: test colour counts equal the row sums of sigma0_60k_final.confusion_color (PASS, manual check 2026-11-07)
colour_label_independence.method: Pearson chi-square (no continuity correction), Cramer V = sqrt(chi2/(n(k-1)))
colour_label_independence.interpretation: No association. Two nominal p < 0.05 (parity x colour, 20k p = 0.022, test p = 0.049) are not significant after Bonferroni over 6 tests (threshold 0.0083); V <= 0.041 in all splits.
colour_label_independence.use_in_paper: one dataset-control sentence in Methods; NOT a claim about task independence in the reservoir
